title: narcissus papyraceus var. gennarii
intro: Narcissus papyraceus var. gennarii, commonly known as Gennari's narcissus, is a plant species in the Amaryllidaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to treat various conditions such as wounds, infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Gennari's narcissus include expectorant, anti-haemorrhagic, and spasmolytic effects, which make it useful in treating coughs, bleeding, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
